content.value: . Consider a steam power plant operating on ideal reheat Ran.kine cycle. Steam enters the highpressure turbine at 15 M Pa and $6 0 0 ^ { \circ } \mathrm { C }$ and is condensed in the condenser at a pressure of 10 kPa. If the moisture content of the steam at the exit of the low-pressure turbine is not exceed 10.4%, determine (i) the pressure at which the steam should be reheated, and (ii) the thermal efficiency of the cycle. Assume the steam is reheated to the inlet temperature of highpressure turbine.
